title: They Found the Ship Perfectly Intact — But Everyone On Board Was Gone
description:
December 4th, 1872. Four hundred miles east of the Azores, the crew of the Dei Gratia spotted a ship drifting with no one at the wheel. Her name: Mary Celeste. Aboard should have been Captain Benjamin Briggs, his wife, their two-year-old daughter, and seven crewmen — but every single one of them had vanished.

The ship showed no signs of storm damage, no blood, no struggle. Six months of food and water sat untouched below deck. Only the lifeboat and a handful of alcohol barrels were missing. Investigators searched for mutiny, piracy, or fraud — and found nothing. Just a ship in near-perfect order, abandoned mid-voyage.

To this day, not one of the ten people aboard the Mary Celeste has ever been found. The ship sailed on for thirteen more years, and every captain after her called her cursed.
